died.name: Legh Richmond
died.desc: Church of England clergyman and writer
died.last_words: Brother, brother, strong evidences, nothing but strong evidences will do in such an hour as this. I have looked here and looked there for them, and all have failed me, and so I cast myself on the sovereign, free and full grace of God in the covenant by Jesus Christ; and there, brother, there I have found peace.

born.name: William Henry Vanderbilt
born.last_words: I have had no real gratification or enjoyment of any sort more than my neighbor on the next block who is worth only half a million.

born.name: George Miller Beard
born.last_words: I should like to record the thoughts of a dying man for the benefit of science, but it is impossible.
